name: Spider Mites
remedies: Wipe down leaves with dilute insecticidal soap or neem oil spray.
Increase surrounding humidity with a misting schedule or humidifier.

name: Aphids
remedies: Rinse leaves thoroughly with a strong blast of water.
Apply neem oil or insecticidal soap every 5-7 days.
Introduce beneficial predatory insects like ladybugs if outdoors.

name: Powdery Mildew
remedies: Prune and dispose of severely infected foliage.
Spray with a solution of potassium bicarbonate or copper fungicide.
Improve air circulation and avoid overhead watering.

name: Root Rot
remedies: Unpot plant and trim away soft, black, or decayed roots with sterile tools.
Repot in fresh, well-draining soil mix using a container with drainage holes.
Allow soil to dry out moderately between waterings.

name: Mealybugs
remedies: Dab individual insects with a cotton swab dipped in 70% isopropyl alcohol.
Apply systemic insecticide or spray neem oil solution weekly.
Inspect leaf axils and undersides regularly.

name: Nitrogen Deficiency
remedies: Apply a balanced, water-soluble N-P-K fertilizer at half strength.
Top-dress soil with organic compost or worm castings.
